baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from sent-down signs through making-clear and guidance to a straight path.
baseline_models.mechanism: The signs arrive within human reach as visible markers, their import is disclosed, and divine guidance conducts a recipient toward a traversable route whose q-w-m quality is rectitude and balance.

activation_trace.role: Delivery into reach supplies the arrival stage of the mechanism.
A visible marker supplies the route-readable signal.
Disclosure by speech or sign makes the marker intelligible.
Gentle direction toward a route supplies conducted orientation.
The road image supplies the traversable object of guidance.
Equilibrium and rectitude qualify the route as normatively sound.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely says that clear revelations point to the right belief.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a complete orientation process: delivered markers become intelligible and a recipient is conducted onto a viable route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The combination of descent, signs, leading guidance, and a q-w-m-qualified path.
baseline_models.mechanism: The signs can be read as waymarks placed in fitting positions; guidance goes ahead as a lead element, while straightness names the support that keeps the route standing and usable.

activation_trace.role: Placement in a fitting station turns the signs into positioned waymarks.
The manifest-marker image makes the positioned elements legible.
A leading element going ahead turns guidance into route-leading.
Support that keeps a thing standing turns straightness into maintained viability.

changed_reading.before: The signs are detachable statements and the path is an abstract line.
changed_reading.after: The signs form positioned wayfinding infrastructure, and the path is an arrangement kept navigable by support and maintenance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordination of clear signs with the separate clause in which God guides whomever He wills.
baseline_models.mechanism: Objective disclosure and successful orientation are related but nonidentical operations: signs can stand manifest, while actual conduction remains an act of divine guidance governed by will.

activation_trace.role: Manifest appearance supplies objective availability of the signs.
Gentle direction supplies the further operation of successful orientation.
Will attached to the selected object prevents clarity from functioning as an automatic cause.

changed_reading.before: Once signs are clear, guidance follows mechanically for every observer.
changed_reading.after: Clear disclosure can be present without completed orientation; the ayah marks divine guidance as the additional, recipient-specific event.

context_deltas.mechanism: Whole-surah repetition turns manifest signs from informational propositions into operating demarcations. They are placed and prescribed, then repeatedly named as signs being clarified after rules that separate permissible from invasive speech, sight, entry, and timing.

activation_trace.role: Separation within the focus adjective lets clarity demarcate alternatives as well as expose them.
Repeated placement in a fitting station makes the surah's signs an installed ordering system.
A bounded, specified obligation gives the installed signs practical force.
Clarification after timed privacy rules shows disclosure functioning through explicit social instructions.
The marker image identifies those practical instructions as the signs themselves.

structural_cues: 24:1 couples the same descent-sign-clarity triad with prescription, and 24:34 repeats the triad with precedent and admonition.
The clarification refrain at 24:58, 24:59, and 24:61 closes detailed rules of access, privacy, and commensality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formulaic repetition beside bounded rules; I infer that clarification builds social boundaries, while the live alternative is that the refrain only comments on verbal explanation.

changed_reading.before: The clear signs primarily convey transparent religious information.
changed_reading.after: The clear signs actively lay out and maintain humane boundaries by making differences of permission, evidence, exposure, and access operational.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning against following a rival sequence of footsteps supplies the negative mechanics of path formation: a route is generated by tracing one effect after another. Guidance to the straight path therefore includes interruption of locally plausible but cumulatively corrupting steps.

activation_trace.role: The focus road is the positive traversable sequence under comparison.
Tracing effect after effect supplies the cumulative mechanism by which a rival route acquires force.
Followable footprints make the rival route granular and locally enacted.

structural_cues: 24:21 repeats both following and footsteps twice before the focus ayah names the straight path.
The intervening rules repeatedly govern small acts whose accumulation changes communal conditions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated step-following warning and a later path; I infer path dependence from their shared locomotion frame, while the alternative is a looser moral contrast without a stepwise mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The straight path is chiefly a final doctrinal alignment.
changed_reading.after: The straight path is also a sequence-dependent practice: guidance redirects the next step before repeated traces harden into another route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The light and darkness sequence makes the baseline gap between disclosure and guidance perceptual. A manifest object can be misestimated as water or remain unseen at arm's length; guidance supplies illumination and interpretive calibration, not merely more visible data.

activation_trace.role: Manifest appearance supplies the objectively disclosed side of the distinction.
Gentle direction supplies the enabled-uptake side of the distinction.
Illumination makes a route and its markers usable rather than merely present.
The exact guidance construction explicitly conducts recipients toward light.
Supposition supplies the faulty estimate by which an apparent sign is misread.
The water-like gleam supplies a legible-looking but false orienting marker.
Failed eye and insight supply the breakdown of reception despite proximity.
Given illumination is the condition that reverses perceptual failure.

structural_cues: 24:35 repeats divine guidance and whomever He wills, while 24:39-40 stage two different failures of perception.
The paired failures immediately precede the weather, alternation, movement, and focus-sign sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies light, mirage, failed sight, and repeated guidance; I infer an epistemic enabling relation, while the alternative is that these images classify outcomes without describing how guidance works.

changed_reading.before: Clear signs and successful seeing are effectively the same event.
changed_reading.after: The ayah distinguishes exposed markers from the illumination and calibration by which a person can actually orient through them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding weather chain activates guidance as directed delivery. Something is gently driven, descends, reaches one target, and is turned from another under the same will formula; the focus can therefore picture guidance as conducting a descended sign into effective contact with a recipient.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above anchors the focus signs to the preceding descent process.
Gentle conducting toward a route supplies the directional analogue.
Gentle driving supplies a noncoercive transport stage.
Weather descent creates the exact delivery echo with the sent-down signs.
Targeted incidence supplies arrival at an intended recipient.
Turning away supplies the contrasting nonarrival branch of the routing process.
Repeated willing governs both incidence and deflection, matching the focus selection formula.

structural_cues: 24:43 stands three ayat before the focus and repeats both descent and whomever He wills twice.
The weather syntax unfolds as a directional chain rather than as a static object description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical and sequential parallels; I infer a hydraulic routing analogy for guidance, while the live alternative is that only divine agency is shared and no transport model should be carried over.

changed_reading.before: Guidance adds directions after the signs have arrived.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance is the directed arrival itself: a descended marker is conducted into effective contact rather than left as undifferentiated availability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The turn of night and day becomes guidance only when sight crosses from alternation to lesson. The focus path is thus not simply the visible phenomenon but the interpretive passage by which a visible marker becomes a governing orientation.

activation_trace.role: The visible marker supplies the phenomenon from which interpretation begins.
The road supplies the resulting orientation reached through interpretation.
Turning a thing from one face to another supplies the observed alternation.
Passage from one side to another activates movement from appearance to import.
Making one condition a lesson for another supplies the interpretive result of that passage.
Insight rather than bare eyesight performs the conversion into orientation.

structural_cues: 24:44 places lesson and possessors of sight directly between selective weather movement and diverse creature movement.
24:46 then names visible signs and guidance in the same local sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternation, lesson, insight, signs, and path; I infer a crossing operation from perception to norm, while the alternative is that lesson names only a conclusion, not a mechanism of guidance.

changed_reading.before: A sign guides by being visibly self-evident.
changed_reading.after: A sign guides when perception traverses from what alternates before the eyes to a lesson that can order movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence operationalizes the path as responsive hearing, willing obedience, and acceptance of adjudication. Clear delivery remains the messenger's task, but guidance occurs as the hearer enters the commanded social relation rather than merely assenting to information.

activation_trace.role: Conducted orientation is the focus operation that the later sequence makes behavioral.
Judgment between people supplies the social decision point at which orientation is tested.
Hearing as understanding and compliance joins reception to action.
Willing compliance supplies enacted movement onto the route.
Repeated obedience establishes the explicit condition attached to becoming guided.
The resulting guidance explicitly identifies compliance as a route of orientation.
Message delivery marks the messenger's bounded contribution to the process.
Clear disclosure qualifies delivery without collapsing it into recipient uptake.

structural_cues: 24:47-50 contrast verbal profession with turning away from judgment; 24:51 supplies hearing and obedience as the opposite response.
24:54 explicitly coordinates obeying the messenger with becoming guided and limits the messenger to clear delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit obedience-to-guidance conditional after the focus; I infer that it enacts the focus path in adjudicative life, while the alternative is that obedience is one consequence of guidance rather than its full social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Guidance to the path is primarily an inward recognition produced by clear speech.
changed_reading.after: Guidance becomes a responsive practice: hearing, accepting fair judgment, and obeying carry clear delivery into shared life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promise of succession and secure establishment followed by the command to establish prayer activates q-w-m as communal maintenance. The straight path is not only individually upright; it supports practices and institutions that can stand, persist, and hold a community in security.

activation_trace.role: Support and subsistence within straightness let the focus path bear communal weight.
Coming after and standing in another's place supplies durable succession.
Empowerment and establishment supply stable capacity for a shared order.
Active care and maintenance turn standing prayer into a sustaining communal practice.

structural_cues: 24:55 moves from succession through establishment to exchanged fear and security.
24:56 immediately converts that promise into sustained prayer, almsgiving, and obedience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies establishment, security, and a q-w-m imperative; I infer that path-straightness includes institutional support, while the alternative is that q-w-m remains confined to ritual performance and adjectival rectitude.

changed_reading.before: The straight path describes the moral line followed by isolated individuals.
changed_reading.after: The path also names a supportable common order whose repeated practices let trust, worship, and security remain standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the adjacent zoological catalogue to a later disability exception; it remains anchored in the focus road and q-w-m straightness through explicit movement and bodily-deviation roots. Render it as a structural resonance that blocks bodily moralization, not as a claim that 24:46 directly legislates disability.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The straight path and the q-w-m adjective immediately after a catalogue of unlike forms of locomotion.

activation_trace.role: A traversable road supplies the shared orientation across different movers.
Rectitude supplies normative straightness whose scope need not be bodily geometry.
Creeping on the earth broadens valid creaturely movement beyond upright gait.
Repeated movement unifies belly, two-legged, and four-legged locomotion without making one form normative.
Loss of sight supplies a body difference explicitly released from social constraint.
Lameness supplies the most direct contrast between bodily gait and moral rectitude.
Repeated removal of constriction prevents bodily difference from becoming exclusion from shared life.

changed_reading.before: Straightness can quietly borrow the image of one normal, upright body moving in one normal way.
changed_reading.after: The straight path is an invariant orientation available across radically different bodies and gaits; bodily nonstraightness is not moral deviation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the sword sense of the road root and the cutting senses of prescription and separation; it remains anchored in the focus path and clarifying adjective and is reinforced by the surah's guarded openings. Downstream prose should call it a cutting-line metaphor for decisive demarcation, never a literal or violent gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The co-presence of a s-r-t path, b-y-n clarification, and q-w-m rectitude.

activation_trace.role: The penetrating cutting edge turns the path into a decisive line through entanglement.
Separation gives that line the function of distinguishing previously entangled sides.
A scored cut supplies the surah-level image of prescribed limits.
A preserving path between straight bounds links guarding vulnerable openings to maintained passage.

changed_reading.before: The straight path is imagined only as a smooth road already lying open.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also a decisive boundary cut through social confusion, preserving a passable line by separating what must not be collapsed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates hospitality and gift branches rather than the ordinary directional sense; it remains anchored in the focus descent and guidance roots and gains support from the exact whomever-He-wills provision parallel at 24:38. Render it only as a secondary relational metaphor, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sent-down signs and divine guidance of whomever God wills.

activation_trace.role: Provision prepared for an arriving guest makes the descended signs hospitable sustenance for travel.
A gentle gift sent within a relation of regard turns guidance from bare direction into bestowal.
Allocated provision supplies the contextual material analogue for bestowed guidance.
The matching will formula ties provision and guidance to selective divine bestowal.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an instruction the traveler must extract from disclosed signs.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance is also travel provision graciously delivered and gifted, enabling the traveler rather than merely commanding direction.

strongest_changes: Clear signs became practical boundary-making infrastructure rather than information alone.
The light, mirage, and darkness sequence sharply separated objective disclosure from enabled perception.
The immediate weather sequence activated guidance as selective, directed delivery under the same will formula.
The post-focus response sequence made guidance enacted through hearing, adjudication, and willing obedience.
The q-w-m path acquired communal support and maintenance, not only geometric straightness.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sits at a hinge: repeated descent-sign-clarity formulas gather the surah's social demarcations, while the immediately preceding movement and perception scenes and the immediately following obedience sequence expose how a clear marker becomes lived orientation.
remaining_uncertainties: The weather-routing mechanism may be a deliberate cross-domain activation or only a lexical echo of divine agency.
The communal support sense of q-w-m may enrich straightness without defining the adjective's primary force.
The cutting-boundary and gifted-provision outliers depend on distant branch images and should remain explicitly exploratory.
